name: Hyperresearch
description: Deep-research harness that turns Claude Code or OpenAI Codex into a multi-step research agent with audited, sourced reports.
whatItDoes: Runs a single research prompt through a multi-stage pipeline and returns a report in which every source is tracked. It is for users of Claude Code or Codex who want rigorous long-form research inside their project folder.
howItWorks: A Python package installs a skill into the host coding agent; the user then invokes /hyperresearch in Claude Code or $hyperresearch in Codex. The pipeline scales its number of steps to the task and includes an adversarial audit pass. An optional extra adds an MCP server so other MCP clients can use it.

requirements.name: Claude Code or OpenAI Codex
requirements.description: Host agent that executes the skill

models: Whatever the host agent uses (Claude or OpenAI models)
